notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: נפש em i laif/breth, mi tanim long 'bel' (ples bilong tingting na laik long Tok Pisin)

notes.subject: kamap strongpela
notes.rationale: דשן em i 'kamap fat', Tok Pisin i no gat 'fat' bilong gutpela mining, olsem 'strongpela/welwet'

notes.subject: מרוה/יורא
notes.rationale: wora bilong givim wara i sanap_long_en — man i givim wara, ren i kamap long em;pictures i wankain

translation: Bel bilong givim brata, ol i mekim em i kamap strongpela; na man i givim wara long ol arapela, em tu ol i givim wara long em.
